status.description: Status is the current status of the WorkspaceSnapshot.

WorkspaceSnapshot.title: Workspace Snapshot
WorkspaceSnapshot.description: WorkspaceSnapshot is a point-in-time checkpoint of the persistent storage of a Workspace. It is backed by a Kubernetes CSI volume snapshot of the Workspace's underlying volume and it is what enables a Workspace to be cloned into a brand new Workspace inside the same Space. A snapshot is taken online (i.e. without stopping the source Workspace) in which case it is a crash-consistent checkpoint, or while the source Workspace is stopped in which case it is a clean one. Snapshots are owned by the Octelium User who created them and they have a lifecycle of their own (i.e. they outlive both their source Workspace and the Workspaces that are restored from them).

octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.WorkspaceSn.title: Spec
octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.WorkspaceSn.description: Spec is the WorkspaceSnapshot specification. It is intentionally empty.

state.title: State
state.description: State is the current state of the WorkspaceSnapshot's lifecycle

workspaceRef.description: WorkspaceRef is the reference of the Workspace that the snapshot was taken from. It is kept even after that Workspace is deleted.

userRef.description: UserRef is the reference of the Octelium User who owns the snapshot.

spaceRef.description: SpaceRef is the reference of the Space of the source Workspace. New Workspaces can only be restored from the snapshot inside that Space.

templateRef.description: TemplateRef is the reference of the Template of the source Workspace.

regionRef.description: RegionRef is the reference of the Region that holds the snapshot. It is the Region that hosted the latest run of the source Workspace and it is where the restored Workspaces are run.

snapshotAt.description: SnapshotAt is the timestamp of the point-in-time cut as it is reported by the storage backend. It is unset until the backend starts taking the snapshot.

readyAt.description: ReadyAt is the timestamp at which the snapshot became restorable.

restoreSizeBytes.description: RestoreSizeBytes is the minimum size, in bytes, of the volume that the snapshot can be restored into. It is reported by the storage backend.

consistency.title: Consistency
consistency.description: Consistency is the consistency guarantee of the snapshot

failure.description: Failure is the reason of the failure of the snapshot, if any.

octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.WorkspaceSn.title: Status
octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.WorkspaceSn.description: Status is the current status of the WorkspaceSnapshot. It is entirely managed by the Cluster and it is read-only.

message.description: Message is a human-readable description of the failure.

unsupported.description: Unsupported means that the Cluster cannot snapshot the Workspaces' storage.

sourceNotFound.description: SourceNotFound means that the Workspace's volume does not exist.

storage.description: Storage means that the storage backend failed to take the snapshot.

unknown.description: Unknown means that the snapshot failed for an unclassified reason.

octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.WorkspaceSn.title: Failure
octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.WorkspaceSn.description: Failure describes the reason of the failure of a snapshot.

octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.WorkspaceSn.title: Source Not Found
octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.WorkspaceSn.description: SourceNotFound means that the Workspace's underlying volume does not exist anymore.

octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.WorkspaceSn.title: Storage
octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.WorkspaceSn.description: Storage means that the storage backend failed to take the snapshot.

octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.WorkspaceSn.title: Unknown
octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.WorkspaceSn.description: Unknown means that the snapshot failed for an unclassified reason.

octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.WorkspaceSn.title: Unsupported
octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.WorkspaceSn.description: Unsupported means that the Cluster is not able to snapshot the Workspaces' storage (e.g. the CSI volume snapshot API is not installed or no VolumeSnapshotClass is configured).

uid.description: UID is the unique UUID value for the object assigned by the Cluster. Read-only.

name.description: Name is the name of the object. It must be unique within a certain API/Version/Kind tuple.

createdAt.description: CreatedAt is the timestamp of creation of the object. Read-only.

updatedAt.description: UpdatedAt is the timestamp of when the object was last updated. Read-only.

displayName.description: DisplayName is the name that can be shown publicly for the object. Doesn't need to be unique.

description.description: Description is used to describe the object in a short sentence. Maximum characters are 1000.

labels.description: Labels is a map of string keys and values to organize objects.

tags.description: Tags is an optional array of tags that classify the Resource.

annotations.description: Annotations is a map of string keys and values that can be used to store arbitrary metadata about the object.

picURL.description: PicURL is the Picture URL of the resource.

resourceVersion.description: ResourceVersion is a unique ID that represent the current version of the resource object. Used by the Cluster to detect updates.

lastResourceVersion.description: LastResourceVersion is the ResourceVersion of the last update of the Resource.

actorRef.description: ActorRef is the object reference to the Actor resource, typically a Session, who is responsible for the current resource change. If ActorRef is not set, then the current change of the resource was done by the Cluster

actorOperation.description: ActorOperation is the gRPC full method triggered by the actorRef to modify the Resource

isSystem.description: IsSystem means that the resource is created by the Cluster and it cannot be managed by the administrators. Read-only.

specLabels.description: SpecLabels is map used internally by the Cluster for quick searches among lists of objects. Read-only.

isUserHidden.description: IsUserHidden means that the resource object is hidden from ordinary Users and should not be exposed via the User APIs.

isSystemHidden.description: IsSystemHidden means that the resource object is hidden by the Cluster and should not be exposed via the APIs.

systemLabels.description: SystemLabels is a similar map to specLabels. Used only by the Cluster.

octelium.api.main.meta.v1.Metadata.title: Metadata
octelium.api.main.meta.v1.Metadata.description: Metadata is the metadata that is common to every Cluster resource. It carries the resource's identity (i.e. its UID and name), its human-readable information as well as the Cluster-managed bookkeeping of the resource's versioning and provenance.

apiVersion.description: APIVersion is the API version of the reference resource

kind.description: Kind is the resource kind. A kind is unique per an APIVersion.

uid.description: UID is the resource object UID. A UID is unique across the entire Cluster.

name.description: Name is the resource object name. A name is unique per a certain kind.

resourceVersion.description: ResourceVersion is the resourceVersion of the resource.

octelium.api.main.meta.v1.ObjectReferenc.title: Object Reference
octelium.api.main.meta.v1.ObjectReferenc.description: ObjectReference is a reference to another Cluster resource. It identifies the referenced resource by its kind and either its UID or its name.
